notes: REVISE SCENARIO ENGINE BUILT, NO UI YET. computeScenarioEffects now handles type 'revise' with params.changes of target category, emi or invest. Every change is a delta against the base plan, so Projection, Dashboard, Net Worth and Decisions pick it up with no new net-worth plumbing. CATEGORY: delta = (newAmount - base) x expenseMul, where base is the live budgeted series state[key] x expMul x expGrowthMul, snapshotted BEFORE journal-derived one-offs are added so a revision replaces the budget and not what was logged. newAmount is a flat nominal figure from the chosen month (Rs 55,000 stays 55,000 until the next revision); only the BASE inflates. A deleted category has no base series, so its revision is ignored and cannot resurrect it. EMI: new shared function emiScheduleFor(e, months) is now the single definition of what an EMI costs when; the engine's emiMonthly and the revise branch both call it, so a revision and a close event cannot contradict each other. Revisions only touch months inside the EMI's active window, so a closed loan is never restarted and newAmount 0 stops it. A step-up event is replaced by the revision for the months it covers. INVEST: not an expense, expenseDelta is untouched. The branch returns contribOverride keyed id_name; the engine uses it in place of the scheduled contribution, masked to active months so a closed instrument is not revived, and retirement contribMul still applies. The breakdown row has kind 'contribution'. The Projection sheet skips contribution rows so the expense section still reconciles with the expense total. STACKING: resolveRevisionStack groups every revise change across ALL scenarios by target; the later from date wins from that month on, earlier ones apply before. Equal from dates: later list entry wins. Verified: rent to 55,000 from 2027-01 and 62,000 from 2029-01 gives base, 55,000, 62,000 in the right months, in either scenario order. newAmount 0 is honoured (presence test, not truthiness). Missing or non-numeric newAmount, bad from, unknown target and unknown ids are ignored. REVISIONS RUN AFTER the other scenario types so retirement expenseMul and contribMul scale the revised amount exactly as they scale the base. VERIFIED in headless Chromium against a fixture: with no scenarios, totalExpense, emiMonthly, netWorth, contribPerMonth, surplus and cashSeries are byte-identical to v2026.05.13.03 (EMI extraction is behaviour-neutral, including a close event and a setAmount step-up). 27 scenario assertions pass, no page errors. NOT VERIFIED: the named guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not present in the HTML file, so they could not be run; they appear to live in console scripts from earlier sessions. Net worth and Dashboard pages were not driven end to end here. KNOWN EDGES: the Decisions helpers _dcOneOffSeries and _dcScenAt classify expense rows by how many months are non-zero and by sign, so a revision confined to two months or fewer reads as a lump, and a revision that lowers an expense (negative delta) will not appear in the _dcScenAt itemisation. Both need a look when the Decisions UI is wired. If two investments share an id, a revision applies to the first. NOT BUILT: revise editor, scenario list summary and type picker; closed-EMI zero row; settlement on its own line; Edit balances port and Instruments page deletion; Decisions/Scenarios merge.
